stayType: Holiday park with caravans and lodges

beachAccess: Direct access to the Blue Flag beach at Challaborough, within 100m
confirmedFeatures: Heated indoor pool with toddler pool, spa, gym, sauna, games room, arcade, soft play, adventure playground, Wi-Fi in designated areas, launderette, shop, bar and restaurant, clubhouse with entertainment, takeaway, kids' clubs
overview: Challaborough Bay is a Parkdean Resorts holiday park set right behind Challaborough beach, next to Bigbury-on-Sea. Guests stay in caravans, lodges or a cottage, with an indoor pool, play areas, kids' clubs, bars and takeaways on site. The beach is within 100 metres of the park.
surfTripFit: Beachfront location with Challaborough and Bigbury on the doorstep and Bantham a short drive away, plus free parking. Busy family park atmosphere rather than a quiet surf base.
